learner_states.readiness_state: Forwarded from existing readiness service; no parallel scoring model

priority: Saved mistake review when completed history contains incorrect or skipped answers
Existing readiness recommendation with its board and variant context
Published Study Library and Flashcards browse fallbacks
actions.active_exam_and_recent_result: Remain in existing dedicated same-session resume and latest-result cards; no duplicate or cross-device resume claim
actions.empty_history: Board setup and published learning actions; progress disclosure says tracking starts after completed practice
actions.unavailable_practice: Uses existing readiness destination/fallback; no fabricated eligible pool

destination_safety.practice: Accepts only local /quiz practice start actions with a non-empty subject/topic and bounded count; preserves query board/variant values
destination_safety.learner_identity: Dashboard uses current request identity and existing learner-scoped services

implementation: SmartStudyHubService selects and validates up to three deterministic actions from existing readiness and continuity evidence.
Dashboard computes the study summary and continuity once and passes those results to the hub.
Mobile action cards use fluid layout, wrap long content, and retain visible focus and touch-sized controls.

verification.tools/Tests/StudyDashboardPreparedHistor: PASS for 0, 1, 25, 100, 500 attempts; mixed-board readiness remains independently scoped
verification.full_doctor_learner_core_flows: PASS, includes new service and equivalence tests

limitations: Active examination continuation is same-browser-session only, as represented by the existing service.
No actual Chromium rendering was available on Android/Termux; responsive evidence is static contract coverage.
